pairs.why: Almost the same image; A is a touch brighter and cleaner, closer to the saturated, smooth finish of the real cards.
B's leather has the soft glossy toy finish and clean pull-tabs of the real cards, while A looks slightly flatter.
In B a spur strap wraps around the ankle and the tabs are riveted, so the boot is built like a real object while keeping the smooth finish.
In A the spur strap wraps the boot and the tabs are riveted, so it is built more convincingly, with the same smooth glossy render.
B's spur is properly strapped around the heel and the volumes are a little firmer, closer to how solidly the real cards are built.
A has the crisp highlights and a buckled spur strap, which matches the polished but not statue-like finish of the real cards.
Nearly identical; A's shading is slightly crisper and more saturated, like the real cards, and B looks a bit soft.
A's spur sits on a strap around the boot and the leather has firmer lighting, so it reads as a better-built object like the real cards.
